description: This file defines the PlaywrightServer class which manages WebSocket connections, browser instances, and modes of operation for the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for initializing browsers, handling connections, and version checks.

classes.name: PlaywrightServer
classes.description: Manages WebSocket server, browser instances, and connection modes for Playwright.

methods.name: _initReuseBrowsersMode
methods.description: Reuses existing browsers matching criteria or launches new ones.

methods.name: _initConnectMode
methods.description: Initializes a connection in 'connect' mode, possibly launching a new browser.

methods.name: _initPreLaunchedBrowserMode
methods.description: Uses a pre-launched browser for connections.

methods.name: _initLaunchBrowserMode
methods.description: Launches a new browser with specified options.

methods.name: listen
methods.description: Starts the WebSocket server on specified port and hostname.
